name: AmA Studio
headline: Good games
Great breaks
subline: Made for your everyday play. Small, bright games you can pick up in a minute and love for months.
description: AmA Studio is a game studio based in Cairo, Egypt. We make small, bright games for everyday breaks.

studio.intro: AmA Studio is a game studio based in Cairo, Egypt. We make small, bright games for everyday breaks, built in Unity and tested until they feel just right.

principles.title: Small games
principles.text: Easy to learn in a minute. Perfect for a coffee break, a bus ride or five minutes before bed.

principles.title: Bigger breaks
principles.text: Every game is built to give you a real moment of fun, then let you get back to your day.

principles.title: Brighter days
principles.text: Friendly worlds, clear colors and no dark tricks. Games that respect your time.
